problem_type: Completed canvas result projection loses current selection
symptom: A successful production shot card has history and resultId but no displayed result
direct_cause: mergeWebNodeOutcome spreads an incoming node with no result over the current node when history already contains the output
class_root: Web canvas outcome merge does not require a completed run's selected result identity to survive a partial snapshot
affected_population: Web projects with successful production shots or partial browser/server canvas snapshots
internal_only_reason: This is Nomi canvas outcome semantics and run identity, not a dependency behavior
invariants: A missing current result in a successful run is restored only when its resultId matches an existing history entry
An explicit user selection and a newer manual run take precedence
generality_proof: The one merge boundary is called by both save and live projection; selecting by completed run resultId spans any result type and does not infer from arbitrary history order.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Preserve or recover the selected completed result across partial snapshots

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Calls mergeWebNodeOutcome for every matching canvas node
Calls projectWebCanvas, which converges on mergeWebNodeOutcome

recurrence.reason: Every partial snapshot with history but no current result can erase a successful run selection
same_class_scan: node scripts/door-map.mjs mergeWebNodeOutcome: one shared writer door

prevention.invariant: Successful run selection is derived only from its recorded resultId when incoming result is absent and no explicit edit exists
prevention.failure_mode: No matching history result means no guessed selection
prevention.strategy: Recover at the shared outcome merge using run identity; retain explicit result edits and newer runs

legacy_paths.rationale: No alternate outcome merge path remains

migration: The next Web projection or save recovers a missing current result only from matching run resultId; no project files are edited in-place.
residual_risks: Real reported project remains read-only until independent validation

invariant_owner_layer.why: All Web canvas save and live projection paths converge here.
